text: Unpopular opinions after shipping my first app 🧵
Your first version should embarrass you a little.
If it doesn't, you waited too long to ship.
Paperwork got my app rejected more times than bugs did.
Nobody cares about your tech stack.
They care whether it fixes their problem.
The best marketing channel is wherever your users physically are.
I'm documenting the whole journey — the wins and the rejections.
